rows.note: Use this for the sage herb or its dried seasoning; it does not mean a wise person.

example.english: I add a little sage when I make chicken soup, and the aroma comes right out.
example.traditional: 我煮雞湯嗰陣加少少鼠尾草，香味即刻出晒嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zyu2 gai1 tong1 go2 zan6 gaa1 siu2 siu2 syu2 mei5 cou2 hoeng1 mei6 zik1 hak1 ceot1 saai3 lai4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a very wise person or venerable spiritual teacher, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: The villagers all respect this sage and consult him whenever something important comes up.
example.traditional: 村民都尊敬呢位智者，遇到大事都會請教佢。
example.jyutping: cyun1 man4 dou1 zyun1 ging3 ne1 wai6 zi3 ze2 jyu6 dou3 daai6 si6 dou1 wui6 cing2 gaau3 keoi5
